attributes.name: ts
attributes.description: Unix epoch seconds when the payload was built

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Payload discriminator: arena (DeepStream agent) | vlm (ask-the-camera narrator)

attributes.name: pipeline
attributes.description: stopped | starting | running | restarting | error

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Human readable pipeline status / last error

attributes.name: streams
attributes.description: Video streams in the DeepStream batch (camera + looping videos)

attributes.name: streams_active
attributes.description: Streams that produced detections in the last 3 s

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: peoplenet | resnet10

attributes.name: precision
attributes.description: TensorRT precision of the running engine (fp32/fp16/int8)

attributes.name: batch
attributes.description: nvinfer batch size of the running engine

attributes.name: infer_interval
attributes.description: Frames skipped between inferences (0 = every frame)

attributes.name: osd_analytics
attributes.description: on when the zone/line overlay is drawn by nvdsanalytics

attributes.name: uptime_s
attributes.description: Linux uptime

attributes.name: pipeline_uptime_s
attributes.description: Seconds since deepstream-app was (re)started

attributes.name: fps_cam
attributes.description: Frames per second on the camera stream

attributes.name: fps_total
attributes.description: Sum of FPS across all streams (inference throughput)

attributes.name: fps_min
attributes.description: Minimum FPS across streams

attributes.name: fps_avg
attributes.description: Mean FPS across streams

attributes.name: fps_streams
attributes.description: Streams present in the last PERF report

attributes.name: infer_mpx_s
attributes.description: fps_total x streammux resolution

attributes.name: msgs_per_s
attributes.description: DeepStream metadata messages received over MQTT

attributes.name: objects_total
attributes.description: Objects in the latest message of every stream

attributes.name: persons_total
attributes.description: Person detections across all streams

attributes.name: vehicles_total
attributes.description: Vehicle detections across all streams

attributes.name: visitors_in
attributes.description: Line crossings into the booth since reset

attributes.name: visitors_out
attributes.description: Line crossings out of the booth since reset

attributes.name: occupancy
attributes.description: People inside the booth zone right now

attributes.name: occupancy_peak
attributes.description: Highest booth occupancy since reset

attributes.name: people_now
attributes.description: Tracked people anywhere in the camera frame

attributes.name: engaged
attributes.description: People in the zone longer than the engage threshold

attributes.name: dwell_avg_s
attributes.description: Average time spent in the booth zone

attributes.name: dwell_max_s
attributes.description: Longest time spent in the booth zone

attributes.name: dwell_last_s
attributes.description: Dwell time of the last person who left the zone

attributes.name: tracks_total
attributes.description: Unique tracker IDs seen on the camera since reset

attributes.name: hot_zone
attributes.description: left | center | right third of the frame with most people

attributes.name: event
attributes.description: visitor_in | visitor_out | overcrowded (cleared after 30 s)

attributes.name: gpu_load_pct
attributes.description: GR3D utilisation from tegrastats

attributes.name: gpu_freq_mhz
attributes.description: GR3D frequency

attributes.name: gpu_temp_c
attributes.description: GPU thermal zone

attributes.name: cpu_load_pct
attributes.description: Aggregate CPU utilisation

attributes.name: cpu_temp_c
attributes.description: CPU thermal zone

attributes.name: soc_temp_c
attributes.description: SoC / junction thermal zone

attributes.name: power_w
attributes.description: VDD_IN from tegrastats

attributes.name: power_gpu_w
attributes.description: VDD_CPU_GPU_CV rail

attributes.name: ram_used_mb
attributes.description: Memory in use

attributes.name: ram_total_mb
attributes.description: Memory installed

attributes.name: emc_pct
attributes.description: EMC utilisation

attributes.name: nvdec_mhz
attributes.description: Hardware decoder clock (0/absent when idle)

attributes.name: vlm_state
attributes.description: starting | running | paused | error

attributes.name: vlm_model
attributes.description: Model tag served by Ollama / llama.cpp (e.g. qwen3-vl:2b-instruct)

attributes.name: scene_caption
attributes.description: One-sentence description of the current frame from the VLM

attributes.name: people_vlm
attributes.description: People the VLM counts in the frame (independent of the DeepStream tracker)

attributes.name: engagement
attributes.description: none | low | medium | high, the VLM's read of the booth

attributes.name: unusual
attributes.description: Anything the VLM flags as out of the ordinary (empty when nothing)

attributes.name: question
attributes.description: Free-text question sent with the ask command

attributes.name: answer
attributes.description: The VLM's answer to the last question, against the latest frame

attributes.name: alert_rules
attributes.description: Plain-English alert rules currently defined (0-3)

attributes.name: alerts_active
attributes.description: Rules the VLM judged true on the last cycle

attributes.name: alert_text
attributes.description: The rules that fired, separated by ;

attributes.name: alert_1
attributes.description: 1 when rule 1 is true on the latest frame

attributes.name: alert_2
attributes.description: 1 when rule 2 is true on the latest frame

attributes.name: alert_3
attributes.description: 1 when rule 3 is true on the latest frame

attributes.name: vlm_latency_ms
attributes.description: Wall-clock time of the last VLM call (frame upload to answer)

attributes.name: vlm_prefill_ms
attributes.description: Time the model spent encoding the image and prompt

attributes.name: vlm_tok_s
attributes.description: Generated tokens per second on the Orin GPU

attributes.name: vlm_prompt_tokens
attributes.description: Tokens in the prompt, mostly the image (~1100 for a 640 px frame)

attributes.name: vlm_completion_tokens
attributes.description: Tokens generated for the answer

attributes.name: vlm_cycle
attributes.description: Narration cycles since the narrator started

properties.description: DeepStream multi-stream vision analytics and the ask-the-camera VLM narrator on the Advantech iCAM-540 (NVIDIA Jetson Orin) via the /IOTCONNECT Snap
